recognize_zh: 四格組合：A 電腦斷層見脾臟內界線清楚、低密度、無邊緣強化的囊腫（紅箭頭）；B 剖面為單房囊腔；C 為纖維性囊壁鄰接充血的紅髓；D 囊壁內襯單層扁平細胞呈 WT-1 核陽性，確認為間皮囊腫。
features: Panel A (CECT): large well-circumscribed homogeneous low-attenuation splenic cyst without wall enhancement (red arrow)
Panel B (gross): bisected spleen with a unilocular cyst at one pole with a smooth to trabeculated inner surface
Panel C (H&E): cyst wall composed of fibrous tissue adjacent to congested red pulp; lining epithelium thin and not well resolved at this magnification
Panel D (IHC): nuclear WT-1 staining in a single layer of flattened lining cells
No atypia, necrosis or parasitic elements (laminated membrane or hooklets) evident
describe_en: The composite shows a contrast-enhanced CT with a large, well-demarcated, non-enhancing fluid-density lesion within the spleen, and a splenectomy specimen containing a unilocular cyst at one pole. Histologic sections show a fibrous cyst wall adjacent to congested splenic red pulp, and WT-1 immunohistochemistry highlights nuclear positivity in a single layer of flattened lining cells. No cytologic atypia, necrosis or parasitic elements are identified. Findings are consistent with a mesothelial (primary, true epithelial-lined) splenic cyst.

ddx.vs: Pseudocysts have a fibrous wall without any epithelial lining, often with hemosiderin and calcification, and lack WT-1 positive lining cells.
Epidermoid cysts are lined by squamous or transitional epithelium that is CK5/6 and p63 positive and WT-1 negative.
Hydatid cysts show an acellular laminated membrane with a germinal layer and protoscolices with hooklets.
Lymphangiomas are multilocular with endothelial lining that is D2-40/CD31 positive and proteinaceous lymph.
